# Fact: Dietary Approach

## Statement

Alex follows a low-carb diet, limiting bread, pasta, and sugar.

## Context

The low-carb dietary approach means eating mostly proteins, vegetables, and healthy fats.
Alex avoids processed foods, sugary drinks, and refined carbohydrates.
This diet supports the fitness routine and energy levels throughout the day.
Exceptions are made occasionally for social meals.
